SvixId.name: svix-id
SvixId.description: Unique message ID, the same on every retry, so use it to deduplicate. Sent by Flexprice Cloud only.

SvixTimestamp.name: svix-timestamp
SvixTimestamp.description: Unix time in seconds when the message was sent. Sent by Flexprice Cloud only.

SvixSignature.name: svix-signature
SvixSignature.description: Space-separated `v1,<base64>` signatures. See [Signature verification](/developers/webhooks/signature-verification). Sent by Flexprice Cloud only.

billing_terms.description: BillingTerms and Instalments are set by create and preview.

end_date.description: EndDate is exclusive; nil for an open-ended commitment, which runs until terminated.

invoiced_at.description: InvoicedAt is when the invoice billing the instalment was finalized.

invoice_label.description:
InvoiceLabel names its instalments on the invoice, after the owner's label. It may use {n} and {of}, which number
the owner's instalments whose labels use them.

value.description: Value is the amount of a fixed term, per instalment on a recurring one; it is nil for a remainder term.

expression.description:
Expression is an optional CEL expression to compute per-event quantity from event.properties.
When set, it replaces Field-based extraction. Property names are used directly (e.g., token * duration * pixel).

field.description:
Field is the key in $event.properties on which the aggregation is to be applied
For ex if the aggregation type is sum for API usage, the field could be "duration_ms"
Ignored when Expression is set.

group_by.description:
GroupBy is the property name in event.properties to group by before aggregating.
Requires MAX aggregation. Windowing comes from the price, so this no longer
implies a meter-level bucket_size.
When set, aggregation is applied per unique value of this property within each bucket,
then the per-group results are summed to produce the bucket total.

multiplier.description:
Multiplier is the multiplier for the aggregation
For ex if the aggregation type is sum_with_multiplier for API usage, the multiplier could be 1000
to scale up by a factor of 1000. If not provided, it will be null.

flat_amount.description:
flat_amount is the flat amount for the given tier (optional)
Applied on top of unit_amount*quantity. Useful for cases like "2.7$ + 5c"

unit_amount.description: unit_amount is the amount per unit for the given tier

up_to.description:
up_to is the quantity up to which this tier applies. It is null for the last tier.
IMPORTANT: Tier boundaries are INCLUSIVE.
- If up_to is 1000, then quantity less than or equal to 1000 belongs to this tier
- This behavior is consistent across both VOLUME and SLAB tier modes

types.BillingTermValueType.description: fixed or remainder; percentage is reserved and rejected as not supported yet

amount.description: Amount is the commitment amount (v1), or computed_commitment_utilized_amount + computed_true_up_amount (v2).

computed_commitment_utilized_quantity.description:
Usage units behind the computed amounts: usage a billing-terms commitment covers counts as utilized at no
charge, and a quantity commitment's true-up counts its unused units.

calculation_expires_at.description: CalculationExpiresAt is when the calculation can no longer be filed, RFC3339.

calculation_id.description: CalculationID is the provider calculation this row was written from. Commit files it.

display_name.description:
DisplayName is the engine's own name for the tax, such as
"Integrated goods and services tax (IGST)".

percentage.description:
Percentage is the resolved rate, such as "18.0". This is what was charged, not the
rate that would apply if the tax were imposed.

reference.description:
Reference is what this row's provider transaction was filed under. It is unique across
every transaction on the account, so it is also the only way back to a transaction whose
id failed to land here.

sourcing.description: Sourcing is whether the jurisdiction followed the seller's address or the buyer's.

tax_code.description:
TaxCode is the product tax category the engine priced against, such as txcd_10000000.
It belongs to the line rather than the rate, so today every row on an invoice carries
the account default. It only varies once tax is calculated per line item.

tax_type.description: TaxType is the tax family, such as vat, igst or sales_tax.

taxability_reason.description:
TaxabilityReason is why the engine charged what it did, such as standard_rated or
reverse_charge. Recorded, not yet rendered.

billing_currency.description: BillingCurrency is the currency the invoice was issued in.

charge_currency.description: ChargeCurrency is the invoice's original (draft) currency.

converted_at.description: ConvertedAt is when the conversion ran.

rate.description: Rate is the frozen rate: billing per 1 charge unit.

rate_id.description: RateID is the fx_rates row used, for reference only; never read again.
